name: How does a detached ADU affect property resale value in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much resale value does a detached ADU usually add in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, or Burbank?
mainEntity.text: How much resale value does a detached ADU usually add in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, or Burbank?

acceptedAnswer.text: A detached ADU can be a strong resale feature, but the value boost depends on how well the project is executed. Buyers respond to usable living space, privacy, architectural fit, and the feeling that the ADU belongs on the property rather than being an afterthought. High-quality construction, good natural light, efficient layouts, and strong curb appeal all help. On the other hand, a poorly placed unit, awkward access, or obvious budget finishes can reduce the return. In many Los Angeles-area neighborhoods, a detached ADU is most valuable when it adds flexibility: rental income, multigenerational living, guest space, or private work-from-home use. Homeowners should think about resale as a design goal from day one. The project should look intentional, not improvised. A well-planned detached ADU often supports value better than simply maximizing square footage.
acceptedAnswer.description: A well-designed detached ADU can improve resale value, especially when it looks integrated with the main home and offers privacy, quality finishes, and functional space. The value added depends on design, lot use, and local buyer demand, not square footage alone.
